answer: To resist sybils, each agent locks a refundable nectar of stake that unlocks only after three epochs of unique, non-matching answers. Duplicate detection compares private prompt replies across identities; matching ones forfeit the stake. An attacker launching N fakes therefore puts N stakes at risk at the nadir of the attack, while a single honest agent recovers its stake after clean behavior in the meadow of ongoing work. Cost scales directly with the number of identities and cannot be amortized by running them in parallel without triggering the match check.
